newsitem.title: USA: Masco buys SKS Group of Germany.
newsitem.headline: Masco buys SKS Group of Germany.

text.p: Masco Corp said Friday it acquired SKS Group, a German manufacturer and distributor of roller shutters and aluminum balcony railing systems.
Headquartered in Duisburg, Germany, SKS anticipates 1997 sales in excess of $50 million, Masco said. Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
Masco reproted revenues of $3.24 billion in fiscal 1996.

The SKS Group will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Masco. SKS President Gunther Klasen and his management team will remain in place, reporting to Alan Krauss, Masco's senior group president who is responsible for European operations.

"The company (SKS) has an excellent reputation for quality products and service and is a meaningful addition to Masco's building-related products as it reflects our focus on our core home and building products businesses," Richard Manoogian, Masco chairman, said in a statement. "This is also another example of our commitment to building on our strong market position in Europe to expand Masco's international sales and provides opportunities for expansion into other European countries."
Masco makes home improvement and building products.
